title: Shadow ops
features:
# New update 📦 #
🛡️ Anti Freeze
Prevents scripts from freezing the player's movement.

🧷 Anti Sit
Prevents scripts from forcing the character to sit.

🌍 Gravity Slider
Allows adjusting the character gravity (0 to 196.2).

⬇️ FastFall
Makes the character fall faster than normal.

☁️ AirWalk
Allows walking in the air as if there was invisible ground.

🎈 Float
Keeps the character floating still in the air.

🌀 Spin
Makes the character spin continuously.

🪂 NoFall
Removes fall damage.

🌙 MoonWalk
Makes the character slide while walking, like a moonwalk effect.

🎯 Team Check ESP
Ignores players from the same team in ESP.

📋 Copy JobId
Copies the current server JobId.

🗺️ Copy PlaceId
Copies the game's PlaceId.

🎮 Copy GameId
Copies the game's GameId.

📊 Copy FPS
Copies the current FPS value.

👥 Copy Players
Copies the number of players in the server.

🔍 Find Empty Server
Finds an empty or low-populated server.
